judgments.note: Municipal appeal is clear (appeal of a ZBA decision). Housing rests on the permit at issue being the 1990 PRD approval that would convert the duplex to three units, with occupancy of the existing third unit at stake (enforcement injunction in 77-4-00); the order says nothing more about what the ZBA decided.
Duplex-to-three-units conversion is new housing per the table; the unit already physically exists, but its occupancy depends on the permit's validity.
The appeal never got past filing-fee and statement-of-questions stage; nothing states on-the-record or de novo review.
Start: only 'mid-August 2002' is stated, so on_or_before 2002-08-31. End: on_or_after the 2002-12-05 order, which set a conditional dismissal that is not observed. 96 days at least.

The amended PRD would have 7 lots (versus the 1987 four-lot PRD), but new residential building lots are not stated.
